name: npp_proximate_points
desc: Real npp PBA distance-transform kernel kernelProximatePoints(short2* input, short2* stack, int size, int bandSize) from libnpp sm_90 npp.cubin, lifted to x86 and run on CPU. Phase-2: per column, walk the band's rows and maintain a stack of sites that can be nearest along that column, popping sites dominated by their neighbours via the 64-bit integer cross-product test dominate(x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x0)= (k1*(y1+y2)+(x2-x1)*((x1+x2)-2*x0))*k2 > (k2*(y2+y3)+(x3-x2)*((x2+x3)-2*x0))*k1 with k1=y2-y1,k2=y3-y2. Stack entries hold (.x=site x, .y=backward pointer = prev site row); tail sentinel (.x=MARKER, .y=last row) at band bottom. Each column independent and a thread only re-reads stack rows it wrote -> pure function of input, ORDER-INDEPENDENT. Params: input@0x210, stack@0x218, size@0x220, bandSize@0x224. 2D launch.
ground_truth: x86-lifted vs independent host stack/dominate reference (sites placed so mid-sites are popped): 0/1024 mismatches, TEST PASSED
